about: Blind set written 2026-10-15 by three persona agents (newcomer / senior / casual) that saw only plain-English operation descriptions — never GiTrust's training data or earlier eval sets. 369 written; 31 removed as near-duplicates (exact or word-Jaccard >= 0.6) of training/dev/eval phrasings; 338 kept. An independent annotator labelled every request blind: same best label on 338/338; 'accept' = the writer's label plus either annotator's harmless alternatives. Never to be trained on.
